name: clock
description: Tells the current local time. Use when Sir asks what time it is or for the current date/time.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone, e.g. 'Africa/Tunis'. Omit to auto-detect from the machine's location.

aspect.description: What Sir asked for: 'time' if he asks the time, 'date' if he asks the day or date, 'datetime' for both.
